subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's operation-aware delivery resolver plus QQBot reconnect drain as the canonical fix for the linked QQBot reconnect message-loss issue?
rationale: The implementation appears correct and well-proven, but it changes central outbound selection and replay behavior where compatibility and duplicate/missing delivery risk are maintainer-owned choices.

options.title: Accept After Final Gates
options.body: Proceed once required exact-head checks are acceptable, explicitly owning the resolver-selection and reconnect-drain semantics as the desired fix.

options.title: Require More Replay Proof
options.body: Ask for additional maintainer or contributor proof around multi-account or upgrade-drain replay before merging.

options.title: Split The Risk
options.body: Pause this branch and split resolver gating from QQBot reconnect drain if maintainers want smaller landing decisions.

recommendation.title: Accept After Final Gates
recommendation.body: Proceed once required exact-head checks are acceptable, explicitly owning the resolver-selection and reconnect-drain semantics as the desired fix.
